meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Remove AI-generated code smells (slop) from branch changes or an explicit file list. Locks behavior with regression tests FIRST, then runs categorized cleanup via parallel `deep` agents in batches of 5, then verifies with quality gates. Covers 10 slop categories including performance equivalences, excessive complexity (object annotations, if/elif variant chains), and oversized modules (250+ pure LOC with mandatory modular refactoring). MUST USE when the user asks to "remove slop", "clean AI code", "deslop", "clean up AI-generated code", "remove AI slop", or wants to clean up AI-generated patterns from recent changes. Triggers - "remove ai slops", "clean ai code", "deslop", "cleanup AI generated", "remove AI slop", "clean up AI-generated code", "strip slop", "ai-slop cleanup".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检测并清理AI生成的代码坏味道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要清理AI助手生成的冗余或低效代码
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect and clean AI-generated code smells
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clean up redundant or inefficient code from AI assistants

howto.what: 收到清理 AI 生成代码的请求时,Claude 会先写回归测试锁住现有行为,然后分批并行清理注释、重复、死代码、过度复杂等坏味道,再跑质量检查;失败就回滚或直接改。超 250 行纯代码的文件会被拆分重构为独立模块。
howto.when: 当用户说“remove slop”“clean AI code”“deslop”等关键词,或要求清理最近变更中 AI 生成的代码模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我清理分支改动里的 AI 生成代码,先跑测试锁行为。
say.note: Claude 会先加回归测试再动手。

say.text: 移除这几个文件的 AI slop,保留解释原因的注释。
say.note: 传入显式文件列表,只处理这些文件。

say.text: deslop,顺便把超过 250 行纯代码的文件拆成模块。
say.note: 触发超大模块重构流程。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude adds regression tests to lock behavior, cleans slop in parallel batches (dead code, complexity, etc.), verifies via quality gates, and rolls back or edits on failure. Files >250 LOC get split.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to 'remove slop', 'clean AI code', 'deslop', or similar, or wants to clean AI-generated patterns from recent changes.

say_en.text: Clean AI-generated code in this branch's changes; lock behavior first.
say_en.note: Claude adds regression tests before editing.

say_en.text: Remove AI slop from these files, keep comments explaining the why.
say_en.note: Uses the explicit file list as scope.

say_en.text: Deslop, and split any file over 250 pure LOC into modules.
